, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results. The WebSurfer's previous result (Step 2) explicitly stated from a Wikipedia snippet: "the 280 m (919 ft) structure was also the tallest building in the world outside of North America from its 1986 completion until 1989." However, the Planner dismissed this specific 1989 date in favor of the Petronas Towers in 1998. The Planner failed to recognize that the Bank of China Tower in Hong Kong (completed 1989) was the immediate successor that held the title until the Petronas Towers were completed in 1998. By ignoring the clear 1989 date provided in the search results and hypothesizing the Petronas Towers as the successor, the Planner made a factual error regarding the timeline and the specific building that surpassed One Raffles Place.
